facts.fact: The UCC, on a strong recommendation of the Inter-Agency Security Committee, directed operators and ISPs to suspend public internet access, SIM sales and outbound roaming from 18:00 on 13 January 2026 until written notice, blocking social media, web browsing, video streaming, email and messaging, with mobile VPNs to be disabled.
The document says that in 2021 authorities blocked social media platforms and ordered a near-total internet blackout lasting several days through polling and vote tallying.
facts.system: 2021 election internet blackout and social media block

facts.fact: The document says that authorities blocked social media platforms during the 2016 general election.
